description:
Olaf and Ollie are two adorable little astronauts who share a big love for space and adventure. Olaf, the curious and playful boy astronaut, dreams of exploring distant planets and discovering the mysteries of the universe. Olie, the sweet and imaginative girl astronaut, loves gazing at the stars and dreaming about galaxies far away.

Together, they sit side by side on the moon,  great adventure begins with a dream — and the best journeys are even more special when shared with someone you love.
